# A test holding a ui.Style builds on every Go target. The shake kept Style,
# which the test names, and promoted the structs and enums its fields hold but
# never a unit, so the Go program named a `Measurement` it did not declare.

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func testAStyleSaysNothingOfItsBorder(t test.Test) {
    var s ui.Style = {}
    t.assert(s.border == "")
}

ui.window(title="t") {
}
